question: In Box: Add the analyst call script to the Q3 earnings hub that Maya Chen created, the one that has the earnings deck in it. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
Done. A couple of notes on how I picked the hub:

- There were three Q3 earnings hubs, and all three contain the same "Earnings deck.pdf" — but only **"Q3 Earnings – Board Materials"** (hub 8402) was created by **Maya Chen** (the other two were created by Omar Haddad and Maya Lopez, so those don't match).
- Found the script: **"Analyst call script.docx"** in the "Earnings Materials" folder (also made by Maya Chen).
- Added it to the hub — confirmed success.
